text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, some time after the Arima Kinen. 
Daiwa Scarlet was furious.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
You change your return schedule whenever 
you feel like it, and you never reply to 
my messages! What on earth are you 
thinking?!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, I haven't had time to get in touch. 
Right now, well... I'm doing some 
training.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: "Training?!"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I've gotta retrain both my mind and 
body!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I'm nowhere near, nowhere near good 
enough. Not yet...!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"...Look at you, all cornered. Just spit 
it out; I promise I'll forget I ever heard 
it."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"...I thought of you as my rival. I swore 
I'd never lose to you, that I was better 
than you..."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
But... in the end, I couldn't win even a 
single GⅠ...!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I thought I didn't care. That my real 
story starts from here! But the night 
before returning home, in a dream—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Daiwa Scarlet crosses the finish line in 
1st place! Meanwhile, her rival Vodka 
finishes... in 5th! A crushing reminder of 
the gap in their abilities!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I got thoroughly beaten again and 
again...! Without even realizing it, I 
started thinking I couldn't win anymore!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
My spirit was totally crushed! There was 
no way I could win! That's why I can't go 
home just yet! ...*sniff*...!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ...It snapped.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...What's her problem? Going and getting 
all mopey on her own...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With those words, Daiwa Scarlet began 
frantically searching the video site.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
The Oka Sho, the Tokyo Yushun (Japanese 
Derby), and then the Tenno Sho 
(Autumn)...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I paste URLs of race videos where I 
competed against Vodka into our LANE chat. 
And then—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: "Don't call me right back, dammit!"

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Shut up! Just be quiet and watch the video 
I just sent you right now!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Haa...? What is this? These are all races 
that I lost...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"Just look! If you don't, I'll burn your 
bike poster!"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Wh-what...! Fine, I get it, I just have to 
look at it, right?!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
“Now, rounding the 4th corner into the 
final stretch! Which Umamusume will make 
the first move?!”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The commentary coming from the smartphone 
sounded familiar. If I recall, that was a 
race I entered with Vodka heavily on my 
mind.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
""...... What's your deal? You're staring 
at me way too much.""

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"...You'll close the gap if I let my guard 
down, won't you? I'm staying aware of 
you."

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
It's not just races. It's during training, 
solo practice... even right now!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...It hurts to admit, but if you weren't 
here, my Twinkle Series would've 
definitely been a lot shallower.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Without even thinking about what "number 
one" meant, I just won and was happy... 
and surely, that was all it was...!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
So――don't go losing your confidence just 
over a little defeat, you dummy!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
If you have time to blubber around 
outside, come and challenge me to a match 
race or something!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I see, that's true. It's only just one 
loss...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
—Alright! Training is officially over! 
We're headin' back tomorrow! And once 
we're home, it's race time!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"I'm gonna win next time for sure. Just 
you wait!"

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ...Hmph, isn't that just what I wanted!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To Daiwa Scarlet, Vodka is more than just 
a rival. It was an incident that made me 
realize that.
